intro: We'd love to hear from you! Whether it's praise, suggestions, or ideas - everything helps us improve this site.
messagePlaceholder: What would you like to tell us?
emailHint: This email doesn't look quite right. A typo perhaps?
privacyNote: Your email is only used to reply and is not stored. For troubleshooting, we automatically collect page, language, browser, and screen size.
errorDetail: Could not send feedback. Please try again later.
errorRateLimit: You have already sent several messages. Please try again later.

rating.label: How do you like this site?

placeholder.bug: Describe the bug: What did you do? What happened? What did you expect?
placeholder.content: What should be improved? Where did you find the error?
placeholder.feature: Describe the feature you'd like to see.
placeholder.accessibility: Which barrier did you encounter? What didn't work?

a11y.anonymNote: You can report anonymously. An email address only helps if you'd like a reply.

page.title: Feedback
page.subtitle: Tell us what works and what doesn't — here, unhurried and with room to write.
page.messageHint: At least 20 characters — the more concrete, the better.
page.consentLabel: I agree that what I enter here may be stored with this feedback.
page.successText: Thank you for writing! Your message is now in this browser's inbox.
page.privacyText: This portal has no feedback server: your message never leaves this browser. It is stored locally so you can find it again below — and you can delete it yourself at any time.

error.emailInvalid: This email address looks incomplete. A typo perhaps?
error.messageTooLong: The message is too long. Please shorten it to 2000 characters or fewer.
error.consentRequired: Please confirm your consent before sending.
error.storage: Your message could not be stored. This browser is not releasing any storage here — in private mode that is normal.

page.inboxNote: Only you see this list. It lives in this browser and is never transmitted anywhere.
page.inboxEmpty: Nothing stored yet. Your first message will appear here.
page.cleared: All stored messages have been deleted.
